body.statement: For every \(P_0\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{ASC}}\) whose observed law is the rational local base \(p_0=p(P_0)\), and under \(\text{ass:local-tangent-fiber-neighborhood}\) for the declared map \(B\), the displayed cell contrasts identify the selected-complier submeasures.  The capacity formulas give valid marginal outer bounds, while \(\underline\Delta(t;p_0)\) and \(\overline\Delta(t;p_0)\) are the separate same-law infimum and supremum over \(\mathcal F(p_0)\), attained by \(P_t^-(p_0)\) and \(P_t^+(p_0)\).  Moreover \(\Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p_0)\subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}[\underline\Delta(t;p_0),\overline\Delta(t;p_0)]\), with no rectangle-equality claim.  Freezing nonzero base signs and retaining the active directional cuts \(\alpha_\psi'Bu\) yields closed rational cells \(P_{v,b}^0\) covering \(\mathbb R^d\), covariance \(\Sigma_0=\{B'\operatorname{diag}(p_0)^{-1}B\}^{-1}\), and a sample-size-free \(\mathfrak G_0\in\mathfrak E\).  This global tangent construction never treats \(p_0+Bu\) as a probability law.
body.justification: The theorem connects the abstract semantic-label experiment to coordinatewise sharp causal effect endpoints while preserving the dependence across quantiles in the full identified set.
body.gap: Imai gives truncation-by-death quantile bounds, Blanco, Flores, and Flores-Lagunes give Job Corps average and quantile wage-effect bounds for always-employed survivors under assignment, Chen and Flores treat always-employed complier means, and Dong and Heiler (2026, Assumption 3.2 and Proposition 3.1) impose complier-conditional weak selection monotonicity and establish sharp mean bounds. None gives the same-law quantile endpoint programs and globally completed tangent label fan used here.
body.consumer: The Job Corps analysis can report simultaneous semantic conclusions about coordinatewise sharp endpoints while separately retaining the nonrectangular same-law joint identified set.

obligation.what_is_open: Close the corrected fan membership conclusion at the identified base \(p_0=p(P_0)\) after the local-neighborhood, cover, and radius nodes are adjudicated.
obligation.obstruction: The same-law endpoint claims are proved, but the frozen theorem used an unrelated \(p_0\), and a compatible base alone does not imply feasibility in every tangent direction.
obligation.attempted: Fiber equivalence, coordinatewise endpoint attainment, and the joint-set outer rectangle are complete; the claim was narrowed only in its local-fan hypotheses.
obligation.partial_result:
The proved fiber equivalence and endpoint-attainment propositions imply
\[
 \Theta_{\mathrm{ASC}}(p)
 \subseteq\prod_{t\in\mathcal T}
 [\underline\Delta(t;p),\overline\Delta(t;p)],
\]
and each coordinate endpoint is attained by a single compatible law, separately for that endpoint.  This is an outer rectangle for the joint vector, not a rectangle-equality claim.  The remaining fan conclusion requires identifying the fan base with \(p(P_0)\) and ensuring that every direction of \(B\) has a local compatible-law neighborhood.
